subject: Evidence request: TTL, archival and deletion proof for EU tenancy
messages:
From: Maggie Lowe <maggie.lowe@brightaudit.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@clearbank.com>
Date: 2026-11-18T09:12:00Z
Subject: SOC2: TTL/archival/deletion evidence for EU tenants

Hi Dylan,

We're preparing the SOC2 evidence package for ClearBank (EU region) and need artifact-level proof of your retention and deletion controls covering the period Jan 2026 - Oct 2026. Specifically we need:

- The authoritative retention policy that maps data categories to TTLs and legal basis.
- A list of storage locations and the lifecycle rules applied (including object-level and backup retention).
- Recent deletion audit logs showing erasure events for at least one production tenant (sample customer identifier: clearbank-prod).
- A short explanation of how backups, replicas, and snapshots are handled with respect to erasure requests and TTL expirations.
- Any runbooks or playbooks used by ops to perform manual erasures and the role(s) authorized to trigger them.

Can you confirm scope (tenant-level vs table-level) and whether you can provide the deletion log CSV and retention mapping by Tue 24 Nov?

Thanks,
Maggie
Maggie Lowe
Senior Auditor, BrightAudit
[brightaudit.com]

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Maggie Lowe <maggie.lowe@brightaudit.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@clearbank.com>
Date: 2026-11-18T10:03:00Z
Subject: Re: SOC2: TTL/archival/deletion evidence for EU tenants

Hi Maggie —

Thanks for the clear list. We can provide the retention policy and storage mapping and runbooks. A couple quick clarifying questions before we assemble the artifacts:

1) Do you need proof for automated TTL expirations only, or both automated + manually-triggered erasure requests?
2) For the deletion logs, is a redacted CSV that includes event_id, tenant_id, object_key, deletion_timestamp, and operator acceptable? We can redact PII from object_key.
3) Will evidence for a single production tenant (clearbank-prod) plus the policy and runbooks satisfy scope, or do you need a second sample for a Dedicated deployment?

We'll loop in Security Ops to pull the deletion audit extract and produce the sample CSV. Grace / Priyom — can you take lead on artifacts (retention_policy_v4.pdf, s3_lifecycle_configs.txt, erasure_runbook_v2.md) and the deletion audit extract? Target to have draft package by Mon 23 Nov so we can validate before your Tue 24 Nov deadline.

Maggie — let me know the answers to Q1–Q3 and any required formats (CSV, PDF) and we'll proceed.

Best,
Dylan
Dylan Brooks
Senior Account Manager, Redwood Inference

- retention_policy_v4.pdf [Attachment: retention_policy_v4.pdf] — authoritative policy mapping data categories to TTLs and legal basis.
- s3_lifecycle_configs.txt [Attachment: s3_lifecycle_configs.txt] — exported lifecycle rules for eu buckets.

- KMS: we are providing a KMS usage summary in the drive appendix rather than raw key logs.
- Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/retention-matrix-clearbank (contains the retention matrix and exported configs).
- HubSpot reference: CBK-8921 (ClearBank SOC2 audit) if you want the ticket.

If you need raw KMS logs or backup restore traces, let us know and we can coordinate an NDA/secure transfer. Otherwise please confirm if the attachments above satisfy the evidence scope or whether you need additional samples (e.g., second tenant or a Dedicated deployment).
